definitions.explanation: A matter of little importance or significance. A somewhat literary or formal word for something trivial.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{些事|さじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧な。
examples.english: Don't get hung up on such trivial matters.

examples.japanese: {些事|さじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれず、⟦{大局|たいきょく}→大局：21554_taikyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: You should look at the big picture instead of getting caught up in trivialities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{些事|さじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}っていた→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧。
examples.english: I was so consumed by trivial daily matters that I lost sight of what was important.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal/literary word for a trivial matter. The character {些|さ} means "a little, trivial." Often used in the context of advising someone not to worry about small things, or reflecting on how trivial concerns distract from larger issues.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Not to be confused with ⟦{匙|さじ}→匙：03886_saji⟧ (spoon), which is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {些事|さじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦こだわる→こだわる：10319_kodawaru⟧ (to be fixated on trivial matters)
- {些事|さじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧とらわれる (to be caught up in trifles)
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{些事|さじ} (trivial daily matters)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{瑣末|さまつ}→瑣末：17805_samatsu⟧: trivial, trifling — a na-adjective describing something as unimportant
- ⟦{些細|ささい}→些細：07160_sasai⟧: trivial, slight — the most common everyday word for trivial matters
